rationale: The user requested a dark theme with purple, blue, and cyan neon gradients. We refine this into a premium 'Deep Obsidian' base with electric accents. To avoid generic AI-slop, we use heavy grain textures, high-end glassmorphism with 1px structural borders, and a sophisticated font pairing.

spacing_and_layout.glass_panel_classes: bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,229,255,0.05)] rounded-xl

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-[#05050A] font-medium hover:bg-primary_hover transition-colors rounded-none border border-transparent shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 hover:border-white/50 transition-colors rounded-none

components.inputs: bg-black/50 border border-white/10 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary text-white rounded-md
components.charts: recharts with custom tooltips, grids disabled or very subtle (stroke: rgba(255,255,255,0.05)), glowing lines for performance graphs

animations.background_particles: TSParticles or pure CSS slow moving radial gradients

media.description: Abstract deep space dark background with glowing cyan and violet particles.

pages.auth: Split screen layout. Left: Hero Background image with glassy overlay. Right: Minimalist form in surface_glass panel. Deep black base.
pages.dashboard: Control Room grid. Top: Overview stats. Middle: Recharts performance graph with glowing neon lines. Floating AI avatar thumbnail. Deep obsidian background.
pages.domain_selection: 3D tilt cards (framer-motion) displaying domains. Hover reveals neon borders. Dark space background.
pages.ai_interview: Immersive view. Split screen. Left: AI Avatar prominent with voice visualizer (canvas/framer-motion). Right: Monaco Code Editor with dark high-contrast theme. Glass header.
pages.feedback_report: Data-heavy but clean. Radar charts, progress bars with cyan/violet gradients. Detailed breakdown panels.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Outfit', 'IBM Plex Sans', and 'Azeret Mono'. Use Outfit for all headings, Azeret Mono for code/stats, and IBM Plex Sans for body.
Initialize tailwind config with the provided color hexes (no generic colors). Map primary to #00E5FF.
For the 3D particles background, use 'react-tsparticles' or a CSS-based glowing orb background behind the glassy surfaces.
Avoid using card components from Shadcn directly if they feel too flat; customize them with the 'glass_panel_classes' provided.
Ensure Monaco Code editor has a custom dark theme that matches the obsidian background.
Install @phosphor-icons/react for icons if preferred over lucide.
